purpose: 4PL ML rescue: one preregistered R mirt strategy on two fixed designs. Committed before any design fit.

reuse.python_mirt_A: PR #145 four_pl_gh_refinement/result.json: GH101 stationary 1.5e-6, GH161 audit 7.75e-3 FAIL, 11 boundaries; not refit
reuse.r_mirt_EM_A: PR #146 run 42065126768: EM GH61/GH101 projected score 4.76/4.75 (EM stopped before optimum); not rerun as a verdict
reuse.java_A: PR #147: not completed within 45 min; not rerun
reuse.tooling_smoke: simdata N2000 J10 seed 1 (not a design dataset): mirt 1.48 bounded BL crashes (optim method 'nlminb' invalid); after patching to L-BFGS-B, 300 iterations made no logLik progress; native unbounded BFGS BL improved EM logLik. Only timing/feasibility was inspected.

A.role: existing failure fixture, unchanged; its failures stay on record

model: P = c + (d - c)/(1 + exp(-a(theta - b))), D = 1, theta ~ N(0,1) fixed (customPriorFun = GH weights), marginal ML, no priors. Common bounds a [.1,5], b [-6,6], c [0,.5], d [.5,1]. R mirt slope-intercept: a = a1, b = -d_R/a1, c = g, d = u.

strategy.step1: EM on GH61, TOL 1e-8, NCYCLES 20000, bounded M-step a1 [.1,5], g [0,.5], u [.5,1], default deterministic starts (identical to PR #146)
strategy.step2: native mirt BL (stats::optim BFGS, analytic BL.grad, reltol TOL = 1e-12, maxit fixed by mirt at 100) with lbound/ubound set to +-Inf, warm-started on GH61 -> GH101 -> GH161; at most 3 BL calls per grid, stopping early when mirt reports convergence
strategy.equivalence: the unbounded BL optimum equals the bounded MLE only if it lies inside the common box; an estimate outside the box is FAIL (OUTSIDE COMMON BOUNDS), never clipped
strategy.snap: values within 1e-6 of a bound are set to the bound before evaluation (c = 0 and d = 1 are reached only asymptotically on mirt's logit scale)
strategy.no_other_strategy: no other optimizer, start, TOL, grid or prior is tried after seeing results

numerical_gates.definition: common evaluator (equivalence_audit.evaluate, m12_diagnostic.scores + feasible_scores, information_audit.information on the active face, step cbrt(eps)); stationary on GH161 objective; GH241 independent audit score <= 1e-5 and |logLik_GH241 - logLik_GH161| <= 1e-3; information PD with condition <= 1e8; inside bounds; zero boundary estimates required for a NUMERICAL PASS

classification: OUTSIDE COMMON BOUNDS > CONVERGENCE FAILURE (objective score) > QUADRATURE ERROR (audit) > WEAK IDENTIFICATION (information) > BOUNDARY SOLUTION (stationary but non-regular) > NUMERICAL PASS

recovery.applies: design B only, after NUMERICAL PASS
recovery.z: (estimate - truth) / Wald SE from the inverse observed information of the common evaluator (GH161)

monte_carlo.runs_only_if: B NUMERICAL PASS and recovery PASS
monte_carlo.design: R = 100 replications: same truth, response seeds 20261106 + r (r = 1..100), same fit.R and gates per replicate
monte_carlo.budget: 20 parallel CI jobs x 5 replications, 330 min per job; if (B fit seconds x 5) > 330 min, MC is NOT RUN and SE/CI is INCONCLUSIVE (compute blocker)
monte_carlo.profile_intervals: only if Wald coverage fails; requires a separate preregistration; labeled PROFILE

decision.R_pass: B NUMERICAL + recovery + MC PASS -> optional R 4PL adapter, scoped to design B ranges, ML, Wald
decision.python: Python remains the engine unless R passes
decision.none: no production switch; FOUR_PL_ML_CERTIFIED_SCOPE stays None
decision.A_and_B: certification scope never extends to A-type data; A failure stays documented
